description: This Java class 'NoopCustomApiRoutesProvider' implements the 'CustomApiRoutesProvider' interface and provides no-op (empty) route implementations for unauthorized and authorized API calls, returning an 'reject' route from Akka HTTP directives.

classes.name: NoopCustomApiRoutesProvider
classes.description: Final class implementing CustomApiRoutesProvider that provides no-op route implementations for unauthenticated and authenticated API access, using singleton pattern.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Returns a route that rejects unauthorized API requests.

methods.name: authorized
methods.description: Returns a route that rejects authorized API requests.
